mapper.update: update ry_business.ry_rental_after_sales_case set case_status = #{toStatus}, finish_time = case when #{toStatus} = 1 then now() else finish_time end, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now(), remark = coalesce(#{remark}, remark) where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and case_id = #{caseId} and case_status = #{fromStatus} and is_delete = 0
mapper.insert: insert into ry_business.ry_rental_after_sales_event (tenant_id, member_id, case_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, content, operator_name, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{caseId}, #{eventType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{content}, #{operatorName}, #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), 0)

insert into ry_business.ry_rental_after_sales_evidence (tenant_id, member_id, case_id, evidence_type, file_url, file_name, file_mime, description, operator_name, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{caseId}, #{evidenceType}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{fileMime}, #{description}, #{operatorName}, #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), 0)

mapper.update: update ry_business.ry_rental_order set order_status = #{toStatus}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and order_id = #{orderId} and order_status = #{fromStatus} and is_delete = 0
